states: Two workspaces with a common prefix now show their full East and West names while the chooser is closed.
Two exactly same-named workspaces still have distinct options and the active ID is visible beside the control.
A shorter name does not change the chooser width. The single-workspace and unavailable-list states are unchanged.
interactions: Desktop Tab reaches the native Organization field in the same order; the focus outline is visible. ArrowDown selects East.
At 320 CSS pixels, touch hits the native control over the whole wrapped label. The emulated browser commits options through the native select.
Selection reaches the existing runtime reads for each exact ID. Retry restores the list and keeps West. No settings writes.
evidence_summary: Twelve completed journeys on both locked production builds, Playwright 1.56.1. Fourteen comparable desktop and phone capture pairs inspected. The API and WebSocket responses were synthetic; no device-native picker, installed service or identity provider was used.
